records.Concise description: The successor to Slush Pool, the first public Bitcoin mining pool, now operated by Braiins with FPPS rewards and Lightning payout support.
records.Deeper researched summary: Braiins Pool carries the lineage of Slush Pool, launched by Marek Palatinus in December 2010. Braiins gradually took over operations, completed acquisition in 2020, and renamed the service Braiins Pool in 2022. The current service uses FPPS accounting and offers Lightning payouts. Slush Pool is therefore modeled as historical lineage inside this canonical profile rather than duplicated as a separate active entity.
Creators / founders: Marek 'Slush' Palatinus — creator of the original Slush Pool
records.Launch / history: Slush Pool launched in December 2010; Braiins assumed operational control over time, fully acquired it in 2020, and rebranded it as Braiins Pool in 2022.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin mining eco: This is the direct lineage from the first public pooled-mining service to a modern pool, making it central to mining history and payout-model evolution.
Important technical or cultural characte: Braiins Pool and Braiins OS are distinct canonical products
Slush Pool is lineage, not a duplicate record
records.Verification basis: Current Braiins materials verify active service, FPPS and Lightning support; Braiins-controlled history materials document the Slush Pool lineage.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not create a second Slush Pool profile unless Master Explore explicitly changes the one-entity-one-profile lineage rule.
Current fees and hashrate are time-sensitive.

records.Concise description: Luxor Technology’s active Bitcoin mining pool, using FPPS-style revenue accounting and global Stratum endpoints.
records.Deeper researched summary: Luxor operates an account-based pool for Bitcoin miners and currently documents global Stratum endpoints plus FPPS-linked reward accounting. Under FPPS, Luxor assumes block-discovery variance and pays miners against accepted work using the pool’s revenue methodology rather than requiring each miner to wait for a pool-found block.
records.Launch / history: Luxor developed its mining-pool business during the late 2010s and remains operational in 2026 as part of the broader Luxor mining platform.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin mining eco: Luxor is a meaningful pool infrastructure profile and also provides a clean relationship to LuxOS firmware without collapsing the pool and firmware into one entity.

Official sources.label: Getting Started with Luxor Mining Pool

records.Verification basis: Current Luxor-controlled documentation verifies active Bitcoin pool endpoints and FPPS-linked pool operation.
Research notes / uncertainties: Luxor’s published FPPS discount/fee values are time-sensitive and should be dated if used in public copy.

records.Concise description: A non-custodial Bitcoin mining pool operated by Bitcoin Ocean LLC / Mummolin that uses TIDES accounting and supports miner-selected templates through DATUM.
records.Deeper researched summary: OCEAN is designed so block rewards can be paid directly from coinbase outputs rather than first accumulating in a conventional custodial pool wallet. Its TIDES system accounts for contributed work while reducing variance, and its DATUM integration lets miners construct transaction templates locally while OCEAN continues coordinating shares and payout accounting. OCEAN also publishes multiple template-policy options; those are pool/miner policy choices and do not change Bitcoin consensus validity.
Creators / founders: Luke Dashjr — co-founder / technical lead associated with OCEAN
records.Launch / history: Announced in 2023 as a successor/relaunch of the Eligius lineage; DATUM public beta arrived in 2024 and current OCEAN materials show continued production use.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin mining eco: OCEAN combines non-custodial payout construction, auditable share accounting, and miner-side template choice, making it a key contemporary alternative-pool model.
Important technical or cultural characte: Lightning BOLT12 payout support for small balances
records.Verification basis: Current OCEAN-controlled documentation verifies active operation, TIDES, non-custodial payout design, and DATUM/template-choice support.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not describe OCEAN transaction-selection policy as Bitcoin consensus.
Do not generalize OCEAN’s payout mechanics to DATUM implementations outside OCEAN.

records.Concise description: An active Bitcoin mining pool built around Stratum V2 and miner job declaration, with a PPLNS-derived reward system called SLICE.
records.Deeper researched summary: DMND positions its pool around Stratum V2’s encrypted transport and Job Declaration workflow so participating miners can build or declare their own block jobs rather than relying only on a coordinator-built template. Its SLICE payout design is PPLNS-derived and divides work into bounded accounting intervals. Current first-party materials document a live pool, but claims such as being the 'first Stratum V2 pool' should remain explicitly attributed to DMND rather than presented as an uncontested historical fact.
Creators / founders: Alejandro de la Torre — founder / CEO
records.Launch / history: Launched publicly in 2025 after development around Stratum V2 infrastructure.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin mining eco: It provides a production-oriented example of Stratum V2 deployment with miner-selected jobs, useful for distinguishing deployed protocol components from the broader SV2 specification.
Important technical or cultural characte: Miner template choice remains policy, not consensus

Official sources.label: Understanding SLICE, PPLNS and Job Declaration

records.Verification basis: Current DMND-controlled site, technical blog, and open-source releases verify active service and the documented SV2 / Job Declaration / SLICE design.
Research notes / uncertainties: Treat 'first Stratum V2 mining pool' as a project claim unless independently framed and dated.
Deployment details can change; avoid implying all miners use Job Declaration at all times.
